summary: Automate bounded session maintenance with evidence
description: Run cheap periodic classification for leaked routes, expired leases, stale opens, retention candidates and WAL growth, with fail-safe mutation boundaries and machine-readable evidence.
acceptance: R1 classification is bounded and non-blocking; R2 only unambiguous test leaks and expired leases may auto-mutate; R3 transcript deletion requires backup manifest hashes and readback; R4 reports before classified protected applied after elapsed and gateway identity; R5 repeated runs are idempotent.
verification: scripts/run_tests.sh tests/hermes_cli tests/gateway -q && timeout 60 hermes sessions maintain && git diff --check
